description:
Activate Darksteel Citadel by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Darksteel Citadel to become a creature until end of turn.
Darksteel Citadel dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Darksteel Citadel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
